plugins.name: mentor
plugins.description: A lean planning harness for Claude Code: an edit gate keeps the repo read-only until the plan is approved, then implementation runs subagents-first — with staged plan review, per-plan build state (deps, deferred work), and local HTML zooms of any subject.

plugins.name: loom
plugins.description: Session harvesting and plugin lifecycle tools: harvest a project's sessions into reusable Claude Code artifacts, learn from a plugin's sessions to auto-improve and republish it, track usage, and run it all unattended on a daily schedule — with every install isolated to its own Claude config dir.

plugins.name: tmux-design
plugins.description: A design standard for tmux console surfaces: panes render themed, column-correct, in-place-refreshing content instead of raw text, verified live in the pane rather than assumed from a file edit.
